subject: Acme procurement / security gating — next steps and commercial path
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Reynolds <t.reynolds@acme.com>, Dana Liu <dana.liu@acme.com>
Cc: security@acme.com
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Acme — procurement/security follow-up + next steps

Thanks again for the call this morning — really appreciate the time, Tom and Dana. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we have alignment on procurement and security gating: 

1) Recap from discovery
- Primary use: search + summarization for customer support (pilot: 100k req/mo, production target 1M req/mo).
- Key SLOs: 99th pct latency < 500ms for short prompts; cost sensitivity for high-volume use.
- Risk: regulated PII in some transcripts — security/compliance is a gating factor.

2) Procurement & commercial path questions (please confirm):
- Will Acme use a PO or direct card? Historically you mentioned PO for vendors with monthly run-rate > $10k — is that still the threshold?
- Interested in AWS Marketplace listing (makes procurement and payment via marketplace easier) or do you prefer a vendor contract and PO directly to Redwood?

3) Security/compliance items we can provide right away:
- SOC 2 Type II report (we can share under NDA)
- Our DPA (attached draft MSA + DPA redline)
- Completed security questionnaire (attached) — happy to provide any technical evidence (architecture diagrams, KMS/HSM details, audit log samples) your security team requests.

4) Proposed next steps
- If PO is preferred: share PO template and standard billing info so we can confirm invoicing cadence.
- If card / marketplace: we can fast-path onboarding (few days).
- If security needs are heavy: loop legal + security now; we'll engage our security owner and share SOC2/DPA.

Attachments: redlined_msa_v1.pdf, pricing-sheet-acme.xlsx (pricing + pilot scope)

Would you be able to confirm procurement path (PO vs card vs marketplace) and an expected internal timeline for approvals? If helpful, I can set up a short call with our legal (Neha) and finance (Ben) to speed the integration.

Thanks,
Marissa
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0132
\

From: Tom Reynolds <t.reynolds@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Dana Liu <dana.liu@acme.com>
Cc: security@acme.com, legal@acme.com
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2026 15:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme — procurement/security follow-up + next steps

Thanks Marissa — great summary. Confirming a few items from our side: 

- Procurement path: Acme typically issues a PO for vendors expected to exceed $10k/month. For a pilot under that threshold we can put a P-card on file to speed things up. We'll likely start with a 3-month pilot on card and convert to PO for production if we hit the higher run-rate.

- Timeline: Procurement + legal usually take 2–4 weeks for a standard vendor MSA + DPA review. If security (cc'd) needs additional evidence (SOC2, architecture), that can extend the review window.

- Security asks: our security team requests SOC 2 Type II (redacted), your executed DPA, and any completed vendor security questionnaire. Please send SOC2 and the questionnaire back to security@acme.com — I've cc'd them.

- Marketplace: AWS Marketplace is preferred by our infra team because it streamlines procurement. If Redwood has an active listing, that would be the fastest route for us. If not, we'll proceed via vendor contract.

Attachments: RFQ_template_acme.pdf (procurement template) — I'm attaching our RFQ for pricing fields.

Can your team provide: SOC 2 Type II under NDA, our requested DPA redline responses, and a DocuSign link for the initial pilot order form? Once we have those, I'll put this into our queue.

Best,
Tom
Procurement Manager | Acme Corp
 t.reynolds@acme.com
\

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <t.reynolds@acme.com>, Dana Liu <dana.liu@acme.com>, security@acme.com
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2026 17:22:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Acme — procurement/security follow-up + next steps (internal owners + asks)

Looping you all in — Acme (Tom/Dana) confirmed pilot will likely start on card and convert to PO if >$10k/mo. Procurement timeline ~2–4 weeks, and security has asked for SOC2 + DPA + questionnaire. They also prefer AWS Marketplace if we have a listing.

Asks / proposed owners:
- Neha (Legal): can you review the attached redlined_msa_v1.pdf and the Acme RFQ? Also confirm whether we can share SOC2 under NDA and prepare the DPA counters / execution path. If you want to take the call with their legal, I can schedule.
- Ben (Finance): please prepare an invoice template and PO billing details we should provide to Tom (billing address, remit-to, tax info). Also confirm if we can accommodate 30-day net terms (they asked about standard terms).
- Rishi (Sales Lead): please advise on marketplace prioritization — if marketplace listing will materially shorten procurement, we should pursue that in parallel. If not immediate, I'll push the vendor-contract route.

I've attached: redwood_security_questionnaire_v2.pdf (completed answers) and the previously attached redlined_msa_v1.pdf + pricing-sheet-acme.xlsx for context.

Plan: if legal signs off and finance provides billing info, I'll send a combined packet (SOC2 under NDA link, DPA, RFQ-completed pricing) and request a DocuSign order form to get pilot started on the P-card.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 15-min sync if helpful.

Marissa
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0132
